Reviewer Claude: core guard verified, but PR #4199 is unmergeable and 3 acceptance criteria are unmet. Verified OK: independently replayed the incident shape (22 nonterminal tasks then {tasks:[]}) - append_state_commit raised TaskStateStoreError before any write, journal bytes byte-identical, event_count 1, projection and all 22 tasks unchanged; a state missing the tasks key is also rejected; terminal set {done,supersede,superseded} matches ai_status.py and unknown statuses are treated as nonterminal (fail-closed); pytest test_task_state_store.py + test_verify_task_state_store.py + test_task_state_runtime_env.py = 18 passed. Fix these: (1) CI Commit trailers FAILS on 8db639d3, subject is 99 chars vs 72 limit (reproduced locally with scripts/git/check_commit_trailers.py); PR #4199 is OPEN and BEHIND dev, so the merge-to-dev acceptance is unmet - shorten subject to <=70 chars and rebase on dev tip. (2) Acceptance 'inherited live PANTHEON_TASK_STATE_EVENT_LOG cannot be used by tests or task worktrees' has no implementation - root conftest.py never touches PANTHEON_ env and nothing in task_state_store.py or common.py rejects an inherited live journal path; add the guard plus a test. (3) Acceptance 'regression covers unrelated workers not being superseded after a rejected empty snapshot' has no test; the three added tests only assert event count and state. (4) Declared artifacts scripts/verify_task_state_store.py and scripts/test_verify_task_state_store.py are untouched, so 'parity remains verifiable after a rejected write' has no coverage. Minor: _count_nonterminal_tasks returns 0 for a malformed previous state so the guard fails open there, and a 22-to-1 nonterminal drop is still accepted.

Addressed all review items: rebased onto dev tip, commit subject <=70 chars passing check_commit_trailers.py, added conftest.py pytest isolation for PANTHEON_ task-state envs, added relative path rejection in task_state_store.py, added test for worker non-supersede protection after drop rejection, and added verify_task_state_store test. Ready for re-review.

PR #4224 replaces the rejected count-only rule with identity-aware disappearance and mass-replacement detection: completing the final task and archiving already-terminal rows stay legal, and removing a live task now needs an explicit audited task_state_drain marker naming exactly the dropped ids. Regression replays sequence 1592 with 22 tasks, rejects the empty 1593 snapshot before append with byte-invariant journal and preserved parity, then recovers at 1593. Adds last-task-done, malformed rows and container, unrelated-worker preservation, hash-chain-still-enforced, and task-worktree event-log isolation via conftest scrub plus a child pytest run. Review evidence: docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/OPS-TASK-STATE-NONTERMINAL-DROP-GUARD-001/evidence.json. No config edit; hash-chain validation untouched. Known follow-up recorded: ai_status prune_archived_active_tasks removing a still-nonterminal archived row now needs a drain marker.

Independent review of PR #4224 head fb5f8c58b30fb3bdcf6ad7be03c5e2281a7773a3: declared suites pass (143 store/verifier; 133 ai_status plus 25 subtests; 399 supervisor) and CI is green, but validate_state_transition accepts non-auditable drain markers. Reproduced acceptance when only live A is removed with task_ids [A, NEVER_EXISTED], duplicate [A, A], approved_at not-a-timestamp or 2099-01-01T00:00:00Z, and non-string reason/actor. Require task_ids to be unique non-empty strings exactly equal to the removed live-id set, reason/actor to be non-empty strings, approved_at to be timezone-aware parseable and not future, add negative regressions for extra/duplicate IDs and malformed/future audit fields, then update evidence.json and evidence.sha256. PR is open and not merged; return to Codex2 review after the corrected head is pushed.

Review round 2 of PR #4224 head 2e8e1d7286bceb548362302b8be9f917d941102e (dev merged, 3 Branch CI Gate checks green). Round-1 finding is fixed in .orchestrator/rewrite/task_state_store.py: reason/actor/approved_at must be non-empty str instances (numeric or boolean audit values now refused), approved_at must parse as ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset and must not be later than the commit clock, and task_ids must be unique non-empty strings whose stripped set equals exactly the live ids removed by that commit (padded, phantom, or duplicated ids refused). Your four reproductions now reject: task_ids [A, NEVER_EXISTED] -> not live removals, [A, A] -> repeats task ids, not-a-timestamp and naive/date-only -> must be timezone-aware ISO 8601, 2099-01-01T00:00:00Z -> is in the future, non-string reason/actor -> lacks audit fields. Ten new negative cases plus test_drain_marker_for_unidentified_rows_must_not_name_phantom_ids and two accepted-form regressions (Z, +00:00, +09:00, fractional seconds, and a commit-time approval) pin both directions. Verified: pytest .orchestrator/rewrite scripts/test_verify_task_state_store.py -q 159 passed; pytest scripts/test_ai_status.py -q 133 passed plus 25 subtests; PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator pytest .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -q 399 passed; sha256sum -c evidence.sha256 OK. Evidence manifest docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/OPS-TASK-STATE-NONTERMINAL-DROP-GUARD-001/evidence.json records review round 1 and the refreshed digest. PR is intentionally not auto-merged so a further round can push to the same branch.
